nodes.label: Technical Design v1.1
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Technical review draft dated 2026-07-02; recommendations and requirements are not evidence of implemented features.

nodes.label: Proposed Unified Domain API
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: MiniProgram and planned iOS/Android clients must share one domain API and business data at /api/v1.
nodes.rationale: Prevent identity, relationships, permissions, media, pet and recap rules from diverging across clients.

nodes.label: Proposed Channel Adapter
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Isolate channel-specific authentication, WeChat subscriptions, APNs/Android push and deep links; app identity binding remains subject to review.
nodes.rationale: Channel differences must not duplicate domain rules or bypass resource authorization.

nodes.label: Proposed Modular Monolith
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Recommended Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x modular monolith, with workers in the same repository and separate processes.
nodes.rationale: Simplify MVP transactions and delivery while preserving domain boundaries for later scaling.

nodes.label: Proposed OpenAPI Contract
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Single OpenAPI 3.x contract, generated DTO/SDK, stable errors, additive evolution and a compatibility window covering store review delays.
nodes.rationale: Avoid hand-maintained client DTO drift while allowing independent client releases.

nodes.label: Proposed MySQL Redis Private Storage Baseline
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Recommended MySQL 8.0 InnoDB for shared domain facts, Redis 7 for sessions/rate limits/idempotency/cache, and private object storage with authorized CDN.
nodes.rationale: Keep relationship authorization strongly consistent and avoid permanent cloud secrets or public media URLs on clients.

nodes.label: Proposed Transactional Outbox
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Write business state, audit and outbox_event in one transaction; publisher may repeat delivery and consumers deduplicate by event_id.
nodes.rationale: Recover after crashes without placing slow object-storage or queue calls inside business transactions.

nodes.label: Proposed Asynchronous Worker
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Workers perform moderation, media processing, deterministic rendering, notification and cleanup; execution must be idempotent.

nodes.label: Proposed AccessScope Authorization
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Owner access or SHARED plus matching current couple, active membership and PAIRED status; media/recap inherit parent authorization; deny by default.
nodes.rationale: A URL or client-side hidden control is not an authorization boundary; reauthorize before returning cached content.

nodes.label: Required Revoke Before Cleanup
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Unbind transaction commits FROZEN and removes active membership before returning; asynchronous finalization must never restore mutual access.
nodes.rationale: Make privacy effective for new authenticated requests immediately while allowing expensive isolation and deletion to recover.

nodes.label: Proposed Media Processing Lifecycle
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: PENDING_UPLOAD to UPLOADED to SCANNING to READY/BLOCKED/FAILED to DELETED; validate owner, object size/hash and callbacks; strip EXIF in display copies.
nodes.rationale: Only READY media may be read by the other partner; failed media remain recoverable and owner-only.

nodes.label: Proposed Deterministic Template Rendering
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Low-resolution client preview and final worker rendering use immutable template version, crop/overlay parameters and params_hash; original publication survives rendering failure.
nodes.rationale: Combine fast previews with consistent final outputs and preserve unmodified originals.

nodes.label: Proposed GenerationJob
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED task states with unique type/input/version/params, retries, lease, progress and error code.
nodes.rationale: Reuse tasks and fixed input versions to prevent duplicate outputs, side effects or charging.

nodes.label: Proposed RecapSnapshot
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: Versioned selected moment IDs, media versions, text, ordering, config and rendering parameters; PRIVATE hard exclusion, sensitive tags default soft exclusion, disclosure manifest.
nodes.rationale: Stable input prevents original edits during generation from creating inconsistent output; export rechecks authorization.

nodes.label: Proposed Signed Timeline Cursor
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
nodes.description: HMAC-protected occurred_at/created_at/id cursor binds normalized query and actor scope; own and shared SQL ranges are filtered before UNION ALL.
nodes.rationale: Avoid pagination drift, duplicates and private-content leakage while handling timezone boundaries.
